== Notes ==
* In [[PvP]], it is common to use a [[cover]] condition for the most harmful condition (i.e. [[Blind]], [[Crippled]], [[Dazed]], and [[Deep Wound]]) you want to keep on your target. Since the amount of conditions doesn't scale, this skill can remove both the cover and the covered condition without any investment of [[attribute point]]s.
** Rangers especially can put this skill to good use since [[expertise]] will reduce its cost.
